title: Pentagon
subtitle: Point up, flat base
description: A pentagon standing on its flat base, which makes it the one shape here that is deliberately asymmetric top to bottom.

Its widest row is not its middle either: the shoulders are about a third of the way down and the sides taper slightly from there. Nothing in the geometry depends on where the widest row is -- the icon's fit walks every row a candidate square would cover.
